config.ultimine_addition.server.progress: Shape IDs unlocked by the Adept Shape Certificate.

A Mining Skill Card reaching Novice, Apprentice or Adept offers one of two perks for its tool, picked in the Skills Record and kept for good.
The most blocks a player-made shape may have, besides the one being broken.
How many shapes of their own a player may keep, drawn in the Shape Designer. 0 turns the designer off.
Shapes added by other mods (FTB Ultimine plugins) that no certificate lists join this certificate. None leaves them to the Miner Certificate and Mine-Go Juice.
With a number of seconds here, a drunk Mine-Go Juice only runs down for that long after each Ultimine, and waits the rest of the time. 0 keeps it a plain timer.
Chance (0 to 1) for a challenge block to count double.
Shape IDs unlocked by the Novice Shape Certificate, for the certificate's tool.
Ink taken from the Skills Record's pen for each reroll.
How many unstarted challenges a card can swap per tier. 0 disables rerolls.
A card reaching Novice, Apprentice or Adept gives a Shape Certificate for that card's tool, which permanently unlocks some Ultimine shapes for that tool.
Every Nth challenge block in a streak counts one extra point. 0 disables streaks.
Seconds allowed between two challenge blocks before the streak resets.
Grants a short Mine-Go Juice for the card's tool when a Mining Skill Card tiers up.
Seconds of free Mine-Go Juice for the card's tool when a card tiers up. 0 disables it.
A challenge everyone on the server shares, picked anew each day or each week. It needs no card: doing it with the right tool counts.
Experience points for finishing the daily challenge (four times as much for a weekly one).
Seconds of Mine-Go Juice for the challenge's tool for finishing the daily challenge (four times as much for a weekly one). 0 disables it.
What one member does for the daily challenge also counts for the teammates who are online (an FTB Teams party, or a scoreboard team).
A tool counts the blocks Ultimined with it; every 500 add a percent to the blocks its Ultimines can take, up to ten.
